# Félix Tshisekedi in 2024: 2B.3 research note

## Bottom line
The record is mixed. Tshisekedi was facing a real armed threat in the east, and he repeatedly used peace processes and ceasefires when they existed. But he also mixed that with force-forward rhetoric, proxy dependence, and regime-survival politics, especially around military buildup and constitutional reform.

## Evidence leaning defensive / threat-driven
- [US issues sanctions on rebel group alliance over conflict in DRC](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/us-issues-sanctions-on-rebel-group-alliance-over-conflict-in-drc-3537087)  
  - **Publisher:** Reuters  
  - **Date:** 2024-07-25  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Reuters reported U.S. sanctions on the Congo River Alliance, which Washington said sought to overthrow the DRC government and fuel conflict. This supports the view that Tshisekedi was responding to a genuine security threat, not inventing one.  
  - **Question IDs:** 2B.3, 2B.2

- [Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi et Salva Kiir appellent au respect des accords de paix](https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_salva_kiir_appellent_au_respect_des_accords_de_paix)  
  - **Publisher:** Présidence RDC  
  - **Date:** 2024-03-25  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Tshisekedi called for an urgent relaunch of the Nairobi and Luanda peace processes and said he would spare no effort to restore peace, security, and stability. That is direct evidence of recognizing diplomacy as a real alternative to force.  
  - **Question IDs:** 2B.3, 2B.1, 1B.4, 1B.8

- [Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi Et Joao Lourenco appellent au respect du cessez-le-feu](https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_joao_lourenco_appellent_au_respect_du_cessez_le_feu)  
  - **Publisher:** Présidence RDC  
  - **Date:** 2024-08-12  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Tshisekedi backed the Luanda process, welcomed the ceasefire, and said his government was available for next negotiation steps. This supports a defensive reading because he kept negotiation alive when a peaceful path existed.  
  - **Question IDs:** 2B.3, 2B.1, 1B.4, 1B.8

- [Les Téké et les Yaka s’engagent à mettre fin aux hostilités dans l’ouest de la Rdc](https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/les_teke_et_les_yaka_sengagent_a_mettre_fin_aux_hostilites_dans_louest_de_la_rdc)  
  - **Publisher:** Présidence RDC  
  - **Date:** 2024-04-06  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Tshisekedi presided over a local peace pact in western DRC, and the parties committed to dialogue, mediation, and arbitration. This is evidence that he could distinguish genuine security management from militarized escalation in at least some settings.  
  - **Question IDs:** 2B.3, 2B.1, 1B.4

## Evidence cutting against
- [Face à la presse, le Président Félix Tshisekedi a peint un tableau d’espoir de la RDC](https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/face_a_la_presse_le_president_felix_tshisekedi_a_peint_un_tableau_despoir_de_la_rdc)  
  - **Publisher:** Présidence RDC  
  - **Date:** 2024-02-23  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Tshisekedi emphasized a major military buildup and framed the eastern security problem in force-forward terms. This weakens a clean defensive reading because it shows militarized and potentially nationalist framing alongside legitimate security concerns.  
  - **Question IDs:** 2B.3, 2B.1, 1B.3, 1B.7

- [Army disarray hobbles Congo's fight with Rwanda-backed rebels, officers say](https://d2233.cms.socastsrm.com/2024/07/04/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say/)  
  - **Publisher:** Reuters  
  - **Date:** 2024-07-04  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Reuters reported that Tshisekedi threatened to declare war against Rwanda, while the same report described reliance on proxy forces and weak discipline. That is strong evidence of escalation and nationalist pressure beyond narrow defense.  
  - **Question IDs:** 2B.3, 2B.2, 1B.6, 1B.7, 1B.3

- [Congo President Tshisekedi draws criticism over constitutional reform plans](https://www.yahoo.com/news/congo-president-tshisekedi-draws-criticism-154945419.html)  
  - **Publisher:** Reuters  
  - **Date:** 2024-10-24  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Reuters said Tshisekedi’s constitutional reform push raised fears that it could remove term limits and pave the way for a third term. This is not a battlefield-security move, but it strongly suggests regime-survival motives were operating in the same political environment as the security crisis.  
  - **Question IDs:** 2B.3, 2B.2

## Search gap
- I found **no direct evidence** that Tshisekedi was driving a fully manufactured war scare or using a pure diversionary war doctrine.
- I also found **no direct evidence** that prestige, revenge, or nationalism were his only motives.
- The evidence instead shows a **blend**: real threat environment, real diplomacy, and real escalation/regime-preservation pressures.

## Best reading
Tshisekedi **did** distinguish genuine defensive needs at times, but **not consistently**. The strongest negative signals are the war threat against Rwanda, proxy reliance, and constitutional-reform politics that made security and regime survival blur together.
